item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01840","case1_error":"Counts all 15 videos in the final round instead of stopping at the fifth, overcounting by 10.","case2_error":"Divides the full weekly requirement by elapsed days instead of dividing the remaining six cups by the remaining two days.","reason":"The first overcounts an unfinished final batch; the second uses total requirements and elapsed days instead of remaining quantities.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01841","case1_error":"Answer marker says 300, but the calculation and explanation correctly give 200 remaining.","case2_error":"Answer marker says 300, but the derivation correctly gives a total cost of 840.","reason":"Both contain answer-marker conflicts with correct derivations; neither establishes a mathematical error mechanism.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01842","case1_error":"Counts only two houses in the combined area, omitting Zion's house.","case2_error":"Omits the 15 cards Rick keeps when subtracting other allocations to find Miguel's share.","reason":"Both omit an explicitly included component when accounting for the requested total or remainder.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01843","case1_error":"Answer marker says 600, but the derivation and concluding sentence correctly give 400 legs.","case2_error":"Treats the average of 15 pounds as the total and incorrectly makes the second dog's consumption double the third dog's.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01844","case1_error":"Gives 74 without supporting calculations; its distance-and-time outline supplies no values establishing that speed.","case2_error":"Incorrectly rearranges R + 2 = F - 4 into R = F - 4 instead of R = F - 6.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported final number; the second visibly changes a correct equation through invalid algebra.","judgment":"different"}]}
